name: chief of staff (igor)
description: Coordinates a trading desk by distributing tasks across six agents, verifying that handoffs between them completed, and interrupting the desk owner only when a decision is required. Explicitly does not place trades, so it sits above execution rather than replacing it.

official.title: Chief of Staff by Игорь
official.description: Runs the trading floor: routes work to six agents, checks handoffs, wakes the desk owner only for decisions. Does not trade.
